name: Shimoda (Shizuoka, Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Shimoda city emblem in white: a disc bearing a green four-lobed device with a ring.
history: Municipal flag of Shimoda, a city in Shizuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 20 December 1958; the emblem dates from 22 December 1958.

features.role: Shimoda city emblem — a disc bearing a green four-lobed device with a ring
